blocks.text: CSS Conic Gradients
CSS conic-gradient() Function

The CSS
conic-gradient() function creates a conic gradient.
A conic gradient is a gradient with color transitions rotated around a center point.
To create a conic gradient you must define at least two colors.
Syntax

background-image: conic-gradient([from angle] [at position,] color
  [degree], color [degree], ...);

By default, angle is 0deg and
position is center.

If no degree is specified, the colors will be spread equally around
the center point.
